interpretation.public_heap_method: Existing developer memory_sample with collect:false,warmup:false;11 calls at frame66 and every60measuredticks, outside command timing. Not a post-full-GC baseline or continuous peak/live-heap measurement.

vm_measurement_methods.scope: Luau update call, including engine callbacks; manual tools and load/start are excluded
vm_measurement_methods.allocation_method: Luau onallocate: sum(max(new_size-old_size,0)) on successful requests; excludes frees, allocator overhead and Rust/JS allocations
vm_measurement_methods.gc_method: Luau paired incremental-step interrupts; includes automatic assists, excludes full collections; timing includes instrumentation overhead

interpretation.native_scope: No Native executable or Cargo build/test was used. Current local Windows Native delivery remains affected by recorded App-Control4551 limitations; this evidence neither retries nor turns it into Native acceptance.
interpretation.no_frequent_gc_requirement: Not established: incremental-step callback counts and coarse allocated-byte snapshots do not measure full collection frequency or prove low pause frequency.

preservation: Only this new compact evidence and bounded harness/log copies are written. No Game payload, full final World/save or large profile JSON is copied; original failed and successful reports remain in cache with byte hashes. This evidence-writing step executes no Core/GPU/test/Native/Cargo workload.
sampler_limits: OFF is the same sampling-capable artifact with profiling window inactive; it is not an ordinary production artifact. Raw OFF zero counters are unavailable observations, not zero allocation or GC.
Probes/sampling active VM counters cover Luau update including engine callbacks. Positive allocator growth is cumulative requests, not live heap, frees, Rust allocation or JavaScript allocation.
Incremental GC interrupt timing includes instrumentation/host scheduling overhead and excludes full collections. Per-frame overlap does not establish all GC causes or OS pause time.

Function counts are biased safe-point samples, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Opt2 inlining, short functions and native bindings are not fully attributed; preserve dropped/truncated/sample metadata.
Three fixed-order runs do not establish causal performance improvement. Concurrent chats/machine work may overlap; no exclusive-window/FPS claim.
Only digest strings and frame scalars are checked after each timed command; full final World/UI/save encoding and profile report happen after timing.

Public phase history records natural battle termination; never force activity, restart, heal or synthesize GPU receipts. All memory_sample calls explicitly use collect:false; raw used heap is not a post-GC retained baseline. Periodic heap diagnostic calls occur outside command timing and can affect the following workload. WASM linear-memory capacity is not live memory, allocation growth, GC frequency or leak proof. No forced collection, replacement API, renderer or Native executable is used.
